label: О
description: The preposition о/об/обо ('about') + prepositional case, with the о/об/обо alternation and verbs of thinking and speaking.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Thinking about something. 1. 'О доме' is the prepositional case of 'дом'. 2. 'Думать о' means to think about. 3. 'О' is used before the consonant.

missions.phrase: Мы весь вечер говорим о работе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Speaking about a topic. 1. 'О работе' is the prepositional case of 'работа'. 2. 'Говорить о' means to talk about. 3. 'О' stands before the consonant.
Strategic focus: Subject of a book. 1. 'О войне' is the prepositional case of 'война'. 2. The phrase names what the book is about. 3. 'О' before a consonant.
Strategic focus: Theme of a song. 1. 'О любви' is the prepositional case of 'любовь'. 2. The phrase tells what the song concerns. 3. 'О' before a consonant.
Strategic focus: Subject of a film. 1. 'О жизни' is the prepositional case of 'жизнь'. 2. The phrase says what the film is about. 3. 'О' before a consonant.
Strategic focus: Remembering a person. 1. 'О тебе' is the prepositional case of 'ты'. 2. 'Помнить о' means to remember about. 3. 'О' before a consonant.
Strategic focus: Dreaming of something. 1. 'О море' is the prepositional case of 'море'. 2. 'Мечтать о' means to dream about. 3. 'О' before a consonant.
Strategic focus: Knowing about a place. 1. 'О городе' is the prepositional case of 'город'. 2. 'Знать о' means to know about. 3. 'О' before a consonant.
Strategic focus: Thinking about a person. 1. 'Об отце' is the prepositional case of 'отец'. 2. Use 'об' before the vowel sound. 3. The verb takes the prepositional case.

missions.phrase: Я ничего не знаю об этом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Knowing about a fact. 1. 'Об этом' is the prepositional case of 'это'. 2. Use 'об' before the vowel sound. 3. A very common fixed phrase.
Strategic focus: Speaking about a field. 1. 'Об искусстве' is the prepositional case of 'искусство'. 2. Use 'об' before the vowel sound. 3. 'Говорить о' takes the prepositional case.
Strategic focus: Thinking about a name. 1. 'Об Анне' is the prepositional case of 'Анна'. 2. Use 'об' before the vowel sound. 3. 'Думать о' takes the prepositional case.

missions.phrase: Интересно, думает ли он обо мне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Thinking about me. 1. 'Обо мне' is the prepositional case of 'я'. 2. 'Обо' is a fixed form before 'мне'. 3. 'Думать о' takes the prepositional case.
Strategic focus: Caring about everything. 1. 'Обо всём' is the prepositional case of 'всё'. 2. 'Обо' is the fixed form before 'всём'. 3. 'Заботиться о' takes the prepositional case.

missions.phrase: Не беспокойся, она спрашивает обо мне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Asking about me. 1. 'Обо мне' is the prepositional case of 'я'. 2. 'Обо' is the fixed form before 'мне'. 3. 'Спрашивать о' takes the prepositional case.
